note: Register EVERY profile's SHA-1 and SHA-256 in Firebase (same Android app). Play Store profile must be filled from Play Console after you enable App Signing.

releaseUpload.label: Client APK/AAB (release build you sign locally)

playStoreAppSigning.label: Play Store installs (Google re-signs the app)
playStoreAppSigning.keystore: Play Console → Test and release → Setup → App signing (or https://play.google.com/console/developers/app/keymanagement)
playConsoleNavigation: Open https://play.google.com/console/developers/app/keymanagement OR Test and release → Setup → App signing
Copy SHA-1 and SHA-256 under App signing key certificate
Also add Upload key certificate SHAs to Firebase if not already registered
playStoreAppSigning.instructions: App integrity Services row is often not clickable. Use Setup → App signing or the direct URL. Register App signing key + Upload key in Firebase.
